title: BOISHOMMO: Holistic Approach for Bangla Hate Speech
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech targeting religious groups within Bangla social media comments.
findings: Hate speech targeting religion was one of the most accurately detected categories. The Random Forest model achieved a high F1 score of approximately 95% for the religion category, suggesting that this type of hate speech is more easily predicted compared to other categories like Class or Political Statement.
